title: owner ui fix batch panel lut ruler

commit.merge_subject: merge: owner ui fix batch panel lut ruler

description:
Owner device feedback 2026-11-13: "saniye saliseler birbirine
karışıyor, kötü görüntü" — the ruler's full-timecode labels crowd
into an unreadable mess on the device. Scale stays 4dp/frame (no
zoom); the fix is the labels' own precision plus one honest spacing
constant.

The collision's real cause, verified in code: MajorLabelSpacingPx was
96f RAW px, but the labels render dp-scaled (labelSmall+tnum, a full
HH:MM:SS:FF is ~76dp) and pxPerFrame is 4dp.toPx() — density-scaled
too. On a 420dpi phone the 96px budget is ~37dp, under one label,
while the ladder picks step 10 (10 x 10.5px = 105px >= 96px), so
~200px-wide labels land on 105px centers and overlap by arithmetic.
At density 1.0 it happens to fit — which is why the host looked fine
and the device did not.

Two changes:

1. The spacing budget becomes 96dp, converted at the call site (the
